title: General Fusion
summary: Canadian fusion company using magnetised target compression.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

General Fusion is developing a magnetised-target fusion approach that compresses plasma with liquid-metal pistons, and has built a demonstration facility in the UK. The design avoids solid first walls and uses liquid metal for heat extraction. Technical validation and funding are the risks.

Technology Exposure

  • Magnetised-target fusion
  • Liquid-metal components
  • Demonstration facility

What To Watch

  • Plasma compression results
  • Funding
  • Plant design

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
